'''Renforra Base''' was a military base established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on [[Renforra]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Specter Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Specter Squadron]], led by [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]], was stationed at Renforra Base.<ref name="CCG-Dutch" />
